title: The Sheet Folded Down the Middle
youtube_title: The Sheet Folded Down the Middle | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A fiddly job goes well when two people take slow halves.
summary: At a school hall being set for a gentle fair, a bed sheet that wanted two people and a fold will go wrong if one person rushes. Milo and Yara split it into two slow jobs, while Grandpa Sol only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
